text:
jane.sec: flagged a drift in Vault transit key ACLs during routine audit. wrapping key for `transit/backups` now has extra members (legacy CI svcaccs). Looks like the key was used by an external partner last week based on object metadata we pulled. Need coordinated rotation + audit enablement.

luke.ops: thanks. can you paste the offending member list?

jane.sec: ```
Found principals:
- svc-ci-legacy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com  <-- unexpected
- vault-service@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

priya.eng: ugh partner-ingest shouldn't be there. when did it get added? any terraform reference?

jane.sec: terraform state doesn't show that binding. looks like a console grant 2026-02-11 per admin audit logs (admin logs only; Data Access was OFF for KMS so we don't have encrypt/decrypt counts).

vault-bot: NOTE: vault/transit key wrapping in use by 12 secrets engines. Affected mounts: backups, partners, sessions.

luke.ops: immediate plan proposal: 1) create short-lived rewrap key (wrap-temporary-<ts>) with strict IAM (only svc-rewrap + vault). 2) enable KMS Data Access audit logs + export to dedicated sink (bigquery) for forensic queries. 3) update Vault transit to point to temp key and do canary rewrap of a single partner artifact. 4) run full rewrap and rotate any SA keys that had access. 5) add IAM Condition on key so only allowed if request originates from infra VPC/serviceAccount. 6) remediate terraform drift and add guardrails.

audit-bot: Recommended sink creation: `gcloud logging sinks create sink-kms-data-access bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-security/datasets/kms_audit --log-filter='resource.type="crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt"'`

priya.eng: I'll own the temp key + rewrap automation. prefer to avoid in-place streaming for large backups; we'll rewrap via compose: decrypt->re-encrypt to new ciphertext streaming, but keep object metadata. will script using `gcsrekey` pattern.

jane.sec: also we should run a quick leak scan for any plaintext S3/GCS objects referencing `backup` names in public logs and binary blobs (just in case someone unwrapped). I'll kick that off.

infra-oncall: maintenance window available 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. can do the full rewrap then. canary earlier off-hours is fine.

luke.ops: RBAC change: remove partner-ingest binding from key immediately, but don't disable old key until rewrap finishes. Need to record the exact removal command in chat for audit.

priya.eng: removal command (will run after key exists):
```bash
# remove member
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-key --location=global --keyring=transit --member='serviceAccount:partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```

jane.sec: good. also create an alert for any future console IAM changes on kms keyrings (we missed this one). add a log-based metric and PagerDuty if IAM changes on keyRing.

audit-bot: sample metric: `logName: "projects/redwood-ops/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity" AND protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.key_ring_name:transit`

luke.ops: Vault change will be `vault write sys/wrapping/config wrap_key="projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-temporary-3332101234"` — will do a canary on vault-private cluster first. rollback plan: repoint to old-key if we see >3% wrap failures.

priya.eng: rewrap sketch (canary):
```bash
# copy one object, re-encrypt to new key, preserve metadata
OBJ=gs://partner-backups/daily/2026-03-23.tgz.enc
gsutil cp "$OBJ" - | gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=- --location=global --keyring=transit --key=wrap-key --plaintext-file=- | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=transit --key=wrap-temporary-3332101234 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | gsutil cp - "$OBJ".rewrap
gsutil mv "$OBJ".rewrap "$OBJ"
```

jane.sec: make sure to snapshot object checksums and store them in incident doc so we can verify integrity. also capture access logs before/after.

infra-oncall: i'll be on the rewrap run. ping me 15m before canary.

luke.ops: permissions: only grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `svc-rewrap@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `vault-service@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. no owners/editors. add conditional binding restricting `request.auth.principal` to infra domain and `resource.name` to transit key.

priya.eng: after rewrap we should rotate any SA keys used by legacy CI (svc-ci-legacy) and remove their long-lived keys; enforce workload identity if possible.

jane.sec: If we find evidence of external download of decrypted backups, escalate to Legal & CISO. i'll run the initial forensic timeline and post results here.

audit-bot: Incident created: INC-20260323-44. Tasks assigned: create key (priya.eng), enable Data Access + sink (luke.ops), remove rogue binding (luke.ops), run rewrap canary (priya.eng + infra-oncall), audit timeline (jane.sec). Next update in 45m.

priya.eng: starting key create now, posting resource name when ready. will also push PR to terraform to prevent console drift.

luke.ops: i'll set up log-based alert and add an entry to runbook about IAM console grants.

jane.sec: thanks. post any commands and outputs here so we have an in-thread audit. :raised_hands:
